description: Where are the schools, how is each state organized, and what does one school hold? The CourseShelf View, in three levels, as a map form the person can click: with no arguments, every state, DC and the territories with their schools, schools with courses held and schools clear (the census's own per-school verdict); with state, how that state is organized (its systems and their members, its state organizations and transfer centers with the schools linked by kind, its transfer frameworks, its transfer model) and its schools counted by IPEDS level (four_year, two_year, under_two_years) and open or closed; with unitid, one school's profile: identity, open or closed, clear and its measure, costs, accreditation statements, and its counts (programs, checklists, courses, catalogs, policies, agreements it is a party to and those it owns, pathways it takes part in, comparability rules it publishes). detail summary (the default) carries counts only; detail full adds the school list of a state, or a school's programs, subjects, agreements, pathways and comparability rules. comparability is a school's own rules for learning from elsewhere; applicability, a person's learning against one checklist, is GoldCheck's and checklist_map's, never stored here. The CourseShelf View pages at ksaworks.com/courseshelf-view are drawn from this same record when they open.

detail.description: summary (default): counts only; full: the lists the pages draw

group.description: Optional, with state: only the schools of this IPEDS level group in the list

state.description: Optional two-letter USPS code of a state, DC or territory

status.description: Optional, with state: only open or only closed schools in the list

unitid.description: Optional: one school's IPEDS UNITID, for its profile
